categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Ruitai New Energy Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical new materials sector, focusing on electronic chemicals and organosilicon materials. Its main products include lithium-ion battery electrolytes and additives, supercapacitor electrolytes, optical materials, and silane coupling agents. The company also engages in research, production, and sales of these materials, serving the new energy and electronics industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis and formulation technologies for lithium-ion battery electrolytes and additives, including proprietary patents related to lithium salts and electrolyte solvents. Production employs industrial-scale processes with strict quality control, including DCS and SIS systems for organosilicon materials. R&D focuses on improving electrolyte performance for high voltage, safety, and temperature stability, with pilot and industrial-scale production capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium-ion battery manufacturers such as CATL, LG Energy Solution, EVE Energy, and New Energy Technology. End markets span electric vehicles, energy storage systems, consumer electronics, and supercapacitors. The company also serves high-end chemical enterprises in organosilicon materials, supplying to sectors like coatings and glass fiber.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jiangsu (Zhangjiagang), Fujian (Ningde), Zhejiang (Quzhou), Sichuan (Zigong), and overseas in Poland and South Korea. Its sales cover domestic markets and international markets, with exports accounting for approximately 25.84% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Ruitai New Energy Materials is positioned midstream in the lithium-ion battery supply chain, producing key chemical materials such as electrolytes and additives that are essential inputs for battery manufacturers. It also operates upstream in organosilicon chemical production and downstream in providing technical services and solutions to battery and chemical product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-safety battery electrolytes, high-voltage electrolyte formulations, lithium salt additives, and new battery technologies including solid-state and sodium-ion batteries. It collaborates with Shanghai Jiao Tong University and industry partners to enhance R&D capabilities. Strategic focus includes expanding product variety, improving technical services, and scaling production to strengthen global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products including lithium-ion battery electrolytes, additives, organosilicon materials, and optical materials. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with some sales via intermediaries. Pricing is negotiated based on raw material costs, market demand, and customer agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Tianqi Lithium, Shenzhen Capchem Technology, and Jiangxi Hongba New Materials in battery chemicals, and international organosilicon giants like Dow, BASF, Wacker, and Shin-Etsu in silane coupling agents. Jiangsu Ruitai is a leading domestic player with a strong market position in lithium-ion battery electrolytes and silane coupling agents, recognized for quality and technological advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.1 billion, a 43.47% decline from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 84.6 million, down 81.86%. The company is in a deep industry adjustment phase with capacity expansion projects ongoing, leading to increased costs and reduced profitability. Total assets were about RMB 10 billion with a slight decrease year-over-year. The company maintains a stable but challenged growth trajectory amid market competition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Ruitai emphasizes high purity, stable quality, and advanced technology in its lithium-ion battery electrolytes and additives, supporting high energy density, safety, and temperature performance. Its silane coupling agents offer superior interface modification for composite materials. The company leverages strong R&D, patented technologies, and close customer collaboration to provide tailored solutions and maintain strong customer loyalty and market position.
